channelTitle: Sore throat creeping in? Grandma's salt gargle
hook: Throat starting to feel sore and swollen? Grandma's fix was always a glass of warm salt water.
remedy: As a classic piece of old-fashioned home wisdom, gargling with warm salt water has been used for generations to make a sore, swollen throat feel a little more comfortable.
steps: Stir about half a teaspoon of salt into a cup of warm water until dissolved
Take a sip, tip your head back, and gargle for 30 seconds
Spit it out and repeat a few times a day as needed
caution: Don't swallow the water, and this one isn't suitable for young children who can't gargle safely yet.
cta: Follow along for more old-school home remedies
